resources.name: Crystal structure of ideal Gd2Zr2O7 pyrochlore

access.notes: Space group Fd-3m (No. 227), lattice constant ≈10.666 Å. Gd at 16d (0.5,0.5,0.5), Zr at 16c (0,0,0), O at 48f (x,0.125,0.125) with x=0.339, O' at 8b (0.375,0.375,0.375). Supercell of 88 atoms (2× formula unit). Defect coordinates are specified in the problem description (V_O48f, Zr_Gd, Gd_int2, Zr_8a, O_8a).
